info.label: Island
info.desc: Rid of Me is the second studio album by English singer-songwriter and musician PJ Harvey. It was released on May 4, 1993, via Island Records. The album marked a departure from Harvey's previous songwriting, being more raw and aggressive than its predecessor. Rid of Me was met with critical acclaim and is cited as one of the greatest albums of all time, ranking at number 153 on the 2020 version of Rolling Stone's 500 Greatest Albums of All Time (up from 406 on the list's previous edition). .

podcast.body: In 1992 (actual release 1993), Steve Albini was sought out by the then-little-known Polly Jean Harvey (referred to as "Vijay Harvey") to record her second album, *Rid of Me*. The album starts almost inaudibly, with Polly strumming an unplugged guitar and her voice distant from the microphone, establishing a palpable tension that explodes in the chorus. This recording captured a raw quality that PJ Harvey would never replicate. "En 1992, Albindli se ha arquecido por un antoncés poco conocido, Vijay Harvey para grabar su segundo disco, Ritof Meag."
